title: Chain Reaction
subtitle: One marble, six dominoes, and an entirely unnecessary bloom.
description: Explore an original SVG causal machine: a rolling marble tips six dominoes, a lever releases a counterweighted cam wheel, and a mechanical flower opens. Play, pause, replay, scrub either way, change speed, or inspect five connected stages on an illustrative hand-authored timeline.
instruction: Follow the chain with Play, or choose a stage to pause and inspect. Scrub backwards to rebuild any moment.
